description: This file defines a React component called 'Settings' that renders a settings page. The page displays runtime configuration information, instructions to modify the API base URL via 'public/config.js', and placeholders for user preferences. It imports React, a layout container component, and a configuration utility function, but does not define any external classes or functions itself.
